caption:
India just crossed 3 lakh EV registrations for the fourth month running. Not a one-off spike - a sustained trend.

India registered 3,33,571 electric vehicles in September 2026, per government Vahan data, up from 3,02,746 in August - the fourth consecutive month above 3 lakh. Q1 2026 alone saw nearly 7 lakh EV units registered, up more than 35% year-on-year, while EV penetration crossed 12% of total vehicle sales for the first time in June 2026. 2025's full-year total was already a record 2.27 million units.

One record month can be a fluke. Four in a row is a market that's actually shifted.

Sources: NewsBytes, Finology Ticker, citing Vahan data (2026)
